entrypoint_configuration_check.scope: Actual image entrypoint configuration comparison, synthetic short secret; network disabled and database deliberately absent. This checks startup configuration, not service health or corporate OAuth.

checks.expected_result: client secret of at least 16 characters

apply_check.scope: Real patch apply command twice against a disposable synthetic instance; no service deployment.

limitations: ARM64 Docker Desktop executes linux/amd64 containers through emulation; physical AMD64 acceptance is separate.
Entrypoint comparison intentionally omits a database and proves only removal of the configuration rejection, not runtime health.
Real company OAuth, full R4 browser/API workflows and model/retrieval acceptance were not rerun for this focused patch.
The original bundle BM25/hybrid retrieval limitation remains unresolved.
